implementation_guide.layout_strategy: The app should use a 'Split Screen' layout. Left side (or Bottom on mobile) is the 'Control Panel' (White bg, clean typography). Right side (or Top on mobile) is the 'Visualization Stage' (Dark/Immersive).

component_mapping.ConfigurationPanel: Shadcn Accordion (for collapsible sections like Size, Color, Pattern)
component_mapping.ThumbnailGrid: CSS Grid (grid-cols-3 gap-2) inside a Shadcn ScrollArea
component_mapping.ActionButtons: Fixed bottom bar in Sidebar or Top Header

universal_guidelines: Use 'Manrope' for all Headings to give a technical/architectural feel.
Use 'Inter' for all UI text for maximum legibility.
The 'Add to Favorites' button should be the Accent Color (Orange).
The 'Download' button should be Primary Color (Blue).
Ensure the Canvas area has a subtle inner shadow to create depth.
Panel thumbnails must have a selected state: Ring-2 Ring-Accent.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds, keep it flat and clean.
